content.short: SafeStake provides safeStake, a trust-minimized middle-layer fostering decentralization of Eth2 staking.
content.description: SafeStake provides a trust-minimized middleware layer that promotes the decentralization of Eth2 staking. By integrating BLS signatures, multi-party computation (MPC), and distributed key generation (DKG) protocols, it helps protect Eth2 validator private keys and enables decentralized control over key management. This design reduces single points of failure and enhances security, resilience, and transparency for Eth2 staking infrastructure.
